name: Dextromoramide
summary: Dextromoramide, a rare and powerful opioid analgesic approximately three times as potent as morphine with a shorter duration. Generally only seen in the Netherlands. Reported as having strange and rapid tolerance behaviour.
doseBasis: NOTE: The drug is reportedly highly unpredicable and has a strange, rapid, tolerance behaviour.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

uses.text: It is subject to drug prohibition regimes, both internationally through UN treaties and by the criminal law of individual nations, and is usually prescribed only in the Netherlands.

pharmacology.en: It is a strong agonist at the μ-opioid receptor. Only one of its two mirror-image forms is active.
pharmacology.zh: 它是 μ 型鴉片受體的強效促效劑，兩種鏡像異構物中只有一種具活性。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它是 μ 型鸦片受体的强效促效剂，两种镜像异构物中只有一种具活性。

sideEffects.en: Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing altogether. Its effects are reported to come on and wear off unevenly, which makes overdose easier.
sideEffects.zh: 它所屬的鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量時可能導致呼吸完全停止。據報告它的作用起落不穩定，因此更容易發生過量。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它所属的鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量时可能导致呼吸完全停止。据报告它的作用起落不稳定，因此更容易发生过量。

fact.en: Dextromoramide was made in Belgium at Janssen in the 1950s, in the same programme that later produced fentanyl.
fact.zh: 右旋嗎啡醯胺在 1950 年代由比利時楊森公司合成，與後來產出吩坦尼的計畫同出一脈。
fact.zhHans: 右旋吗啡酰胺在 1950 年代由比利时杨森公司合成，与后来产出吩坦尼的计划同出一脉。
